specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Portable, Easy to Use, Rechargeable, High Definition Printing

features: 【Portable and Easy to use】This B1 bluetooth label printer weighs 293 grams and can be held with one hand, making it easy to carry around. Compatible with IOS and Android, not suggested for use with Pad. For PC use: Connect via USB cable (driver installation required)

【Multi-scene Uses】This compact labeler supports label widths from 20-50mm, which is widely used in supermarkets, shops, clothing, jewellery, small businesses, office, school, and home organization. It is ideal for DIY crafts, New Year, Christmas and holiday gift for your family and friends

【203 DPI High Definition Printing】The inkless sticker maker uses thermal technology, no need for ink and saving you on consumables. It produces high-definition printing clarity with a resolution of 203 dpi, offering sharp and clear imaging

【Powerful Software】The NIIMBOT app offers various label templates, 20+ languages, 100+ frames, and 1500+ symbols. You can customize the style of these elements as you like. The software can automatically detect the label papers and supports batch printing of the same/different labels, very efficient

【1500mAh Rechargeable Battery】The wireless printing machine enjoys long battery life (about 2 hours) without frequent charging. Charging time is 3-4 hours with a Type-C port for convenience. The smart label printer automatically turns off when stopped for about 15 minutes to save power
